连接外部宿主并确认待办交接: Connect an external host and confirm work handoff
查看外部 Agent 的连接和交接状态: Read the external Agent connection and handoff status
建立或续期外部 Agent 连接: Create or renew an external Agent connection
拉取当前待办及准确回执: Fetch current work and its exact delivery receipt
确认已收到当前准确待办: Acknowledge receipt of the exact current work
断开当前外部 Agent 连接: Disconnect the current external Agent host
续期时使用当前连接返回的 session_id: Use the current session_id when renewing the connection
外部客户端主动连接和拉取；平台不启动模型、宿主或定时任务: The external client connects and fetches work; the platform does not start models, hosts or scheduled tasks.
连接、拉取、回执与断开不改变经营记录、公司版本或现金；连接到期、重启和恢复后失效: Connect, fetch, receipt and disconnect do not change company records, revisions or cash. Connections expire and are invalid after restart or restore.
连接和拉取不表示接手选择；明确 ACK 只表示收到，decision.claim: Connecting or fetching does not claim a selection. Explicit ACK confirms receipt; decision.claim confirms processing.
每家公司同一时刻只连接一个宿主；续期沿用 session_id，已接手选择不重新: One host connects per company at a time. Renew using the same session_id; claimed selections are not dispatched again.
回执必须对应当前 request_key 与 receipt_id；改选后的旧回: Receipts must match the current request_key and receipt_id. Old receipts conflict after a changed selection.
执行失败、超时或结果不明时先核对准确记录，不自动重新执行外部行动: On failure, timeout or unknown outcome, reconcile exact records before resuming; do not automatically repeat external actions.
连接能持续接收经营选择的外部 Agent 宿主: Connect an external Agent host that can continuously receive company choices
使用获授权公司的读写凭据建立连接；凭据只放在客户端安全配置中: Connect using an authorized company read/write credential kept in the client's secure configuration.
运行 scripts/agent-host.py 或实现这些 HTTP 合同，持: Run scripts/agent-host.py or implement these HTTP contracts to fetch work continuously and renew before expiry.
接收待办后持久记录准确 request_key，再提交 ACK；选择处理前核对最: Persist the exact request_key before ACK. Check the current event and use decision.claim before processing a selection.
将 player_output、story_context 和当前事件传给自己的: Pass player_output, story_context and the current event to your Agent. Claiming work does not authorize external payments or messages.
结算时保存准确结果引用，尽量通过同一次原子导入结算并准备下一事件；预备草稿不能提: Save exact result references and use one atomic import to settle and prepare the next event where possible. Drafts do not change the ledger.
短篇收束后提供继续或暂停的方向，不替玩家决定新的目标；失败或结果不明时核对记录后: After a chapter closes, offer continuation or a pause without choosing a new goal for the player. Reconcile failed or unknown results before resuming.
Agent 连接已失效，请重新连接: The Agent connection expired. Reconnect to resume.
Agent 连接未绑定此凭据或会话: This credential or session does not own the Agent connection.
Agent 名称须为 1 至 120 字，连接时限须为 1 至 120 秒: The Agent label must contain 1 to 120 characters and the lease must be 1 to 120 seconds.
这家公司已有活跃的 Agent 连接: This company already has an active Agent connection.

Agent 连接已变化，请重新读取: The Agent connection changed. Read its current state.
玩家选择或经营状态已变化，请读取当前待办: The choice or company state changed. Fetch the current work.
接收回执不匹配当前已发送待办: The receipt does not match the current dispatched work.
Agent 连接未绑定此凭据: This credential does not own the Agent connection.
